name: shift-scheduler
description: Build a fair weekly shift rota from your team's availability. List who can work when — any shift, a day off, named shifts like 早班/晚班 or a time window like 10-18 — set each person's maximum weekly hours, and define the shifts and how many people each needs. Shifts are shared out evenly by hours while respecting maximum hours, one shift a day and a minimum rest between shifts (no closing then opening). Understaffed shifts are highlighted so you can fix them. Export a rota workbook, a printable HTML rota and a calendar file for each person. Runs locally; no account or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 根据大家能上班的时间，排出一张公平的每周排班表。写上每个人哪天能上什么班——全天、休息、早班/晚班这样的班次名，或 10-18 这样的时间段——再设每人每周最多工时，定义班次和每班需要几个人。按工时平均分配班次，同时遵守工时上限、每天一个班、两班之间的最短休息（不会晚班接第二天早班）。缺人的班会标红，方便调整。导出排班 Excel、可打印的排班网页，以及每个人的日历文件。在本地运行，不用登录，无需 API 密钥。
